title: Analyzing Cognitive Differences Among Large Language Models through the Lens of Social Worldview

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLMs using the Social Worldview Questionnaire (SWQ), a dataset of 640 Likert-scale items designed to measure four canonical worldviews (Hierarchy, Egalitarianism, Individualism, and Fatalism). The models are tested under different experimental conditions (basic prompt, self-awareness of human review, and explicit peer feedback loops) to observe intrinsic orientations and cognitive adaptability.
